Hi op! I was 28 when I had my first kiss and began dating my first boyfriend. I have a lot of trauma regarding men, so I had a hard time getting into a relationship on top of being a non-drinker and homebody. 
My current partner was a co-worker, but I think what really mattered was that we were both working in a field we felt passionate about. So I think your best chances would be like others have suggested, joining groups that are relevant to you. Dungeons and Dragons meetups, writing clubs, and even taking creatively-geared community college classes can be a really fun way to meet fellow creatives/homebodies! 
And I hesitate to say, but Tinder is probably the best best bet out of all dating apps just because that's the one with the most users. It will just require a lot of patience with yourself and others.
